title: Ergopyrone, a Styrylpyrone-Fused Steroid with a Hexacyclic 6/5/6/6/6/5 Skeleton from a Mushroom Gymnopilus orientispectabilis.
authors: Lee, Seulah; Kim, Chung Sub; Yu, Jae Sik; Kang, Heesun; Yoo, Min Jeong; Youn, Ui Joung; Ryoo, Rhim; Bae, Han Yong; Kim, Ki Hyun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蘑菇中新型甾体化合物的分离与结构鉴定，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: A styrylpyrone-fused ergosterol derivative, ergopyrone (1), was isolated and structurally characterized from a mushroom, Gymnopilus orientispectabilis, along with five biosynthetically related metabolites (2-6). Compound 1 features an unprecedented hexacyclic 6/5/6/6/6/5 skeleton that would be formed from ergosterol and styrylpyrone precursors via [3 + 2] cycloaddition. The chemical structure of 1 was elucidated by conventional spectroscopic and spectrometric data analysis coupled with computational methods including DP4+ probability and ECD simulation and an NOE/ROE-based interproton distance measurement technique via peak amplitude normalization for the improved cross-relaxation (PANIC) method. Plausible biosynthetic pathways of 1-6 are proposed, and compound 6 significantly regulated lipid metabolism in adipocytes through the upregulation of the mRNA expression of Adipsin, Fabp4, SREBP1, and ATGL.
abstract_zh: 从蘑菇 *Gymnopilus orientispectabilis* 中分离并结构鉴定了一种苯乙烯基吡喃酮融合的麦角甾醇衍生物——ergopyrone (1)，同时获得五种生物合成相关代谢物 (2-6)。化合物 1 具有前所未有的六环 6/5/6/6/6/5 骨架，推测由麦角甾醇和苯乙烯基吡喃酮前体通过 [3 + 2] 环加成反应形成。通过常规光谱和质谱数据分析，结合计算方法（包括 DP4+ 概率和 ECD 模拟）以及基于 NOE/ROE 的质子间距离测量技术（通过峰振幅归一化改进交叉弛豫 (PANIC) 方法），阐明了化合物 1 的化学结构。提出了 1-6 的合理生物合成途径，其中化合物 6 通过上调 Adipsin、Fabp4、SREBP1 和 ATGL 的 mRNA 表达，显著调节脂肪细胞中的脂质代谢。
